briefdescription.para: Generate an equality comparison for one or more pairs of loaded values.

detaileddescription.para: This is used in the case where the memcmp() call is compared equal or not equal to zero.

briefdescription.para: A memcmp expansion that compares equality with 0 and only has one block of load and compare can bypass the compare, branch, and phi IR that is required in the general case.
A memcmp expansion that only has one block of load and compare can bypass the compare, branch, and phi IR that is required in the general case.

detaileddescription.para: This function also analyses users of memcmp, and if there is only one user from which we can conclude that only 2 out of 3 memcmp outcomes really matter, then it generates more efficient code with only one comparison.
